summary: Mapped ticker relationships for the outdoor living, fixtures/furnishings, and consumer-durable component supplier chunk. This group is mostly underfollowed and consumer-adjacent rather than obvious consumer brands. The common Serenity question is whether these companies have durable distribution/channel/component positions tied to repair, remodel, outdoor living, RV/marine, housing, hospitality, and facility refresh cycles, or whether they are simply cyclical demand proxies. No fresh filings were pulled in this call; company-specific facts are limited to the provided Layer 1 candidate chunk and cached Serenity context, while ticker relationships are labeled mostly as hypotheses requiring verification.
